baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive agent noun at word 1 governs the open relative object of present-tense willing at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The act-creation branch of the first root and the will-intention branch of the second form a closed causal pair: willing selects, while intensive agency repeatedly realizes. The line profiles a standing conversion of intention into event rather than a merely unused capacity.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being supplies the realization side of the mechanism, with the intensive form making that efficacy recurrently available.
Will and intention supply the selecting side whose unspecified object is then enacted.

changed_reading.before: He can do whatever He wants.
changed_reading.after: He is the ever-ready actualizer of whatever enters His will; the emphasis falls on intention becoming event, not on bare ability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots under both the intensive doer and the verb of willing carry relational branches even before context is opened.
baseline_models.mechanism: Soliciting another toward an act and mutual action activate a field in which agency encounters agency. On this reading the focus does not imagine will in isolation; it presents an actor whose efficacy persists where intentions meet, contend, or try to redirect one another.

activation_trace.role: Soliciting someone toward an act, including contention with another's will, supplies the relational pressure within willing.
Mutual action between two parties turns efficacy into something exercised amid other agents rather than in an empty field.

changed_reading.before: His willing is a solitary inward preference.
changed_reading.after: His willing is sovereign agency operating where wills meet, solicit, and resist one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive action at word 1 is paired with a willing-root branch of gentleness, waiting, and deliberate pace at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deliberate-cadence branch prevents intensive agency from being equated automatically with haste. Recurrent efficacy can select timing and manner as well as outcome, so delay need not signal blockage.

activation_trace.role: Act-production supplies efficacy and keeps the model anchored in actual rather than merely contemplated doing.
Gentleness, waiting, and measured movement supply a chosen cadence for the effective action.

changed_reading.before: If He wills an event, it must happen immediately.
changed_reading.after: His unimpeded action may include measured unfolding, waiting, or gentleness; intensity names dependable efficacy, not speed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distributes agency across sitting, doing, and witnessing: the trench party remains stationed over the spectacle, witnesses what it does, and divine witnessing encompasses every thing; the focus then names the divine subject by intensive doing. The focus consequently reads as counteragency rather than detached observation.

activation_trace.role: Repeatedly bringing action into being supplies the active pole that answers the context's spectacle of watched violence.
Sitting in watch or ambush supplies a fixed spectator posture against which intensive action becomes morally charged.
The same act-producing root names the perpetrators' finite deed, creating a direct agency contrast with the focus.
Presence with direct witnessing makes the perpetrators' observation part of their complicity rather than neutral knowledge.
Comprehensive witnessed presence supplies the divine observational pole that the later intensive doer converts into efficacy.

structural_cues: 85:6-9 moves from seated perpetrators, to what they do, to human and divine witnessing before 85:16 names the divine subject as an intensive doer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared action vocabulary, repeated witnessing, and seated observation; I infer that the later intensive noun answers the earlier spectacle with efficacious counteragency. A live alternative is that 85:16 asserts power generally without a direct anti-spectator contrast.

changed_reading.before: The line is an abstract statement that God has unrestricted power.
changed_reading.after: The line refuses to leave complete witnessing as passive: finite agents watch and enact violence, while the intensive divine doer retains the counteraction that their spectacle cannot exhaust.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promised appointment gives action a fixed horizon, while forgiveness protects a wrongdoer from the deed's effect. Together with the intervening failure to repent, these cues strengthen the baseline possibility that effective will deliberately leaves an interval rather than acting at once.

activation_trace.role: Measured slowness and waiting supply the focus-side possibility of purposive timing within willing.
Actual production ensures that delay remains a mode of effective action rather than inability.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place supplies a scheduled horizon instead of instant execution.
Covering a fault and shielding its bearer from its effect makes deferred consequence compatible with purposeful mercy.

structural_cues: The sequence includes a promised day, then explicitly notes that the persecutors did not repent, and only afterward reaches the forgiving predicate and the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, an interval marked by failed repentance, and protective forgiveness; I infer that the interval can be a willed opening rather than a failure to act. Alternatively, these may be independent descriptions with no timing nuance intended in the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Doing whatever He wills means immediate intervention whenever power is present.
changed_reading.after: Doing whatever He wills includes fixing an appointment and sustaining a merciful interval; deferred fulfillment can itself display control over timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair assigns both first production and renewed production to the same subject. A non-dominant recurrence branch under the focus verb of willing then becomes activated: intensive doing governs not just the first event but the transition from once to again.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being anchors both initial and renewed realization in the focus's intensive agency.
The packet's non-dominant mapping supplies repetition and folding-back as an exploratory recurrence axis, not as a replacement gloss for the surface verb.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the first half of a repeatable temporal circuit.
Return after departure and seconding after a beginning supply the circuit's renewed realization.

structural_cues: The coordinated present-tense verbs for beginning and returning immediately precede the attributive sequence that culminates in 85:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit begin-return pair plus an exploratory repetition branch under the focus root; I infer that will controls the passage from first occurrence to recurrence. The pair may instead refer to one specific resurrection claim rather than a general temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an unlimited series of unrelated acts.
changed_reading.after: The focus can describe authorship of recurrence itself: the same will initiates, restores, and makes an ended configuration occur anew.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same subject is characterized by overpowering seizure, protective covering of fault, and affection before being named the intensive doer of what He wills. The focus therefore gathers opposed-seeming operations without collapsing one into another: severe taking and restorative love are both live modes of enacted will.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention provide the common selector across the context's different modes of action.
Conduct as an actor's stable deed-quality lets the focus gather a repertoire rather than name one isolated intervention.
Taking with overpowering force supplies the severe mode in the repertoire.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer from the consequence supplies a restorative mode.
Love and affection prevent the restorative mode from being reduced to mere suspension of punishment.

structural_cues: 85:12-16 is one compact predicate chain: severe grasp, beginning and return, forgiveness and love, throne and glory, then intensive action and will.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sharply different adjacent predicates of one subject; I infer that they specify the range and character of the otherwise open phrase 'what He wills.' Alternatively, the attributes may simply coexist without qualifying how the focus's willing operates.

changed_reading.before: Unrestricted will is most naturally read as sheer punitive force or arbitrary choice.
changed_reading.after: Unrestricted will names a character-bearing repertoire in which severe seizure, restoration, and affection remain distinct but equally actionable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward scene moves from intended human work, through acts fitted against corruption, into continuously flowing provision. Against that sequence, intensive divine doing can be read as result-making across scales: finite acts are answered by a durable environment rather than by a single compensating event.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to undergo action supplies the transformation from finite work into an enduring resultant condition.
Intended action and work supply the finite human input to the mechanism.
Fitness or suitability of an act supplies the qualitative relation between the input and its non-corrupt outcome.
Continuous provision and giving supply duration, turning reward from a moment into a maintained world.

structural_cues: The clause of belief and fitting work is followed immediately by gardens whose rivers keep running and by the declaration of great success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite intended work, suitability, and continuous provision; I infer a divine result-making arrow from the former to the latter. A live alternative is that the verse promises juxtaposed reward without depicting the focus's action as a transformation process.

changed_reading.before: Doing whatever He wills consists of discrete interventions.
changed_reading.after: His doing can convert bounded human action into sustained ecology and provision, making durable conditions rather than only isolated events.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors act upon believers and try to bend them away from their commitment. Those cues activate the focus root's branch of soliciting or contending with another's will and its mutual-action branch. Divine efficacy is therefore shown amid real rival efforts, not by pretending that no other agency acts.

activation_trace.role: Contending with or redirecting another's will supplies the focus-side model of volition in a relational struggle.
Action between parties supplies the reciprocal field in which unequal agencies nevertheless remain visible.
The perpetrators' act-production supplies a finite but consequential rival agency within the narrative.
Bending someone away from truth supplies the coercive direction of the persecutors' agency.

structural_cues: The believers remain grammatically distinct objects of what the persecutors do, while their belief remains the explicit reason for persecution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human action upon believers and a branch of coercive bending; I infer that the focus answers a contest of wills while preserving the reality of finite agency. The principal uncertainty is whether the contention branch should activate the Form IV surface or remain only an exploratory root echo.

changed_reading.before: Divine freedom means no other will or action is narratively real.
changed_reading.after: Divine freedom is efficacy amid contested agency: persecutors can act and try to redirect belief, yet their coercive field does not delimit what the intensive doer can realize.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, enclosure becomes protective care and complete holding, while revelation is located on a writable or buildable surface and kept through continued guardianship. These material and custodial cues revise action from event-production alone into infrastructure: doing can establish, contain, and continuously maintain a communicative order.

activation_trace.role: Making and causing effects anchor preservation as a positive mode of doing rather than mere absence of change.
Protective enclosure and care supply the containing operation that keeps an order intact.
A broad surface used for writing or building supplies a material substrate on which the maintained order can be fixed.
Adherence and continual maintenance supply duration to the act of guarding the inscribed order.

structural_cues: 85:20-22 proceeds from encompassing the deniers, to recited revelation, to a preserved inscribed substrate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure-as-care, a writable building surface, and maintenance; I infer that the focus's action includes constructing and preserving communicative infrastructure. Alternatively, these cues may describe revelation alone without expanding the semantics of divine doing.

changed_reading.before: Action means producing a new visible event.
changed_reading.after: Action can also mean building the conditions of intelligibility and continually keeping them from loss; preservation is active efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah surrounds the open object of willing with promise, witness, recitation, and preservation. This creates a public-evidence mechanism: what is willed is announced, witnessed, repeatedly voiced, and guarded, so unrestricted efficacy need not mean opaque caprice.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supply the open choice whose relation to declaration is being revised.
A spoken promise that opens expectation makes a future act publicly anticipatable.
A witnessing sign supplies public traceability rather than private, inaccessible preference.
Reading, recitation, and causing others to read supply repeatable public articulation.
Guarding what is held keeps the declared terms available against erasure.

structural_cues: The opening oath invokes a promised day and witness, while the ending answers ongoing denial with recited and preserved discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anticipation, witness, repeatable recitation, and guarding; I infer a ring in which will voluntarily makes its future action legible. The alternative is that these are evidentiary themes around judgment but do not qualify the apparent openness of 'whatever He wills.'

changed_reading.before: Whatever He wills suggests unpredictable action with no publicly stable relation to creatures.
changed_reading.after: His freedom can self-bind at the level of disclosure: the action remains His, yet its horizon is promised, witnessed, recited, and preserved rather than capriciously concealed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus action root into parental causation and nurture. It remains anchored in word 1 and gains contextual support from repair, maturation, and affection; downstream prose should label it a split-mapping activation, not a lexical gloss of the surface form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 under the non-dominant mapped inventory, reinforced by nearby predicates of lordly repair and affection.

activation_trace.role: Parental nurture, including causing existence or correction, supplies an exploratory developmental mode of intensive agency.
Repair, nurture, and bringing to completion echo the developmental operation supplied by the split focus mapping.
Affection supplies the relational quality that keeps nurture distinct from mere domination.

changed_reading.before: The intensive doer executes outcomes over passive objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the intensive doer can also bring what He wills into being, repair it, and carry it toward maturity as a nurturing agent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fabrication image is form-distant and includes ethically negative uses, so it cannot be substituted directly for the focus noun. It remains useful because it is a supplied branch of the focus root and the later context names denial and a guarded record; render it only as a reversal between reality-making and counter-story-making.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1's contrivance branch, reversed rather than asserted as the surface meaning of the divine predicate.

activation_trace.role: Contriving reports or making without a prior model supplies both the dangerous fabrication image and the possibility of unprecedented origination.
Contradiction of truth locates fabricated counter-narration with the deniers and enables the ethical reversal.
Guardianship of the record supplies resistance to the deniers' attempted narrative erasure.

changed_reading.before: The conflict is only between divine power and human disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a conflict between reality-making and counter-story-making: denial can fabricate an account, but it cannot unmake what enacted and preserved will originates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising and branch-distant, but it is doubly anchored in supplied branches under both focus roots and is activated by the nearby begin-return pair. It should be rendered explicitly as a mechanism metaphor, never as a dictionary translation of either focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus roots at words 1 and 3 activate a handle and a turning implement as a coupled material analogy.

activation_trace.role: An axe or adze handle supplies the coupling by which directed force becomes effective work.
A handle, axle, or implement that turns supplies the pivoting motion of will within the analogy.
Return after departure supplies the temporal reversal that the imagined pivot effects.

changed_reading.before: Will and action are two adjacent abstract attributes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, will is the pivot and action the handle that couples intention to force, turning a beginning into a return.

strongest_changes: The repeated action root and the sequence of seated and divine witnessing turn abstract omnipotence into counteragency within a witnessed atrocity.
Promise, failed repentance, and forgiveness make deliberate delay a live mode of effective will rather than evidence of blocked action.
The adjacent begin-return pair activates recurrence: will governs both first production and renewed production.
Severe grasp, forgiveness, and affection keep multiple modes of volition alive without reducing the focus to punishment alone.
Enclosure, inscription, recitation, and guarding expand action into preservation and make unrestricted will publicly legible rather than merely capricious.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two split root inventories opened unusually productive cross-domain paths: contested willing, measured cadence, recurrence, nurture, and a handle-pivot analogy. The context then alternated witnessed violence with sustained reward, force with affection, first creation with return, and declaration with preservation, allowing several incompatible-looking but anchored readings to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The contention, deliberate-pace, and turning-tool branches are root-level activations whose distance from the Form IV surface must remain visible.
The non-dominant mappings toward parental nurture and repetition are structurally supplied but too distant to use as ordinary lexical glosses.
Contextual adjacency supports the proposed causal arrows but does not prove that every surrounding predicate semantically qualifies the open object of willing.
The anti-spectator reading and the deliberate-delay reading remain productively tense: one stresses eventual counteraction, while the other resists demanding immediate intervention.
